final_messages: Candidate HEAD is the pinned a568e73, so round 0 is the sanity gate.
The numbers are identical to the copy committed earlier; only the timestamps in `run_meta.json` differ. Now I'll copy and pack.

The sandbox is set up and round 0 has finished. The sanity gate passed (`sanity.within_tolerance: true`). I haven't edited anything in the candidate checkout yet.

**Setup**
- `EDSHIELD_ALLOW_DOWNLOAD=1` is exported and added to `~/.bashrc`.
- The bench is cloned on branch `claude/compassionate-ritchie-tpkgv9` with its `judge` submodule and installed in editable mode.
- The candidate is on branch `candidate`, created from `main`. Its HEAD is **a568e73a6c34d40335802235db81950e84004ab1**, the pinned commit, so round 0 counts as the sanity gate.
- edshield **0.2.0** resolves from **`/workspace/edshield/edshield/__init__.py`**. The summary also records `installed_from: /workspace/edshield` and `rules_sha256 8e7f0fdf…`.
- The uploaded files are copied into place. `make raw` downloaded CoMTA and MathDial and printed their checksums. `make plant-check` printed "sealed planted set reproduced".

**Round 0** (ONNX runtime on CPU; all numbers from `results/candidate/round_0/summary.json`)

| | Round 0 | Baseline | Delta |
|---|---|---|---|
| Deterministic view, all-identifier recall (n=2841) | 0.8997 (CI 0.888–0.910) | 0.9032 | **−0.35 pp** |
| Deterministic view, student names (n=2014) | 0.8803 | 0.8843 | −0.40 pp |
| LLM view, all-identifier recall (n=2767) | 0.9183 (CI 0.908–0.928) | 0.9183 | **0.0 pp** |
| LLM view, student names (n=1967) | 0.8892 | 0.8892 | 0.0 pp |
| Control, CoMTA (flags per 1,000 tokens) | 0.50 | 0.50 | 0.0 |
| Control, MathDial (flags per 1,000 tokens) | 15.10 | 16.21 | −1.113 |

- **Sanity:** the deterministic-view delta is −0.35 pp against a 0.5 pp tolerance, so `within_tolerance` is **true**. The −0.35 pp gap comes mostly from name–word collisions (−2.07 pp on that category); the summary notes the sealed baseline was run on a GPU with the Python runtime.
- **Misses:** 285 on the deterministic view, mostly nicknames (185) and name–word collisions (58), with 22 rule gaps. The LLM view has 226 misses, 188 of them nicknames.

**Already in the bench repo:** the clone came with committed `results/candidate/round_1`, `round_2`, `driver_rescore` and a `proposals/` directory (PROPOSAL.md, round_1/2 patches, kept_rounds.json, DRIVER_CHECK.md). These are from an earlier session, not this run. This run's round 0 overwrote the committed round 0 with identical metrics; only the timestamps in `run_meta.json` changed. I haven't touched the old proposals. When I start the proposal rounds, my files will overwrite them unless you'd rather I move them aside first.

**Outputs:** `round_0/` (without `raw/`) is copied to `/mnt/session/outputs/results/candidate/round_0/` and packed into `/mnt/session/outputs/outputs.tar.gz`, with paths relative to the bench root.

Ready for the task message.
